description: Sharing my process when we welcome a new brand at the agency  #metaadstips #facebookadvertisingtips #metaadsspecialist #facebookadstips #metaads
transcript: I'm working on a creative workflow for a 2 million dollar a month brand and I thought I would take you behind the scenes in how the process starts. Now this brand has essentially hired made or me to come in and be the connection between their in house creative team and also their actual media buying agency so even though we do the media buying as well sometimes brands will hire us more as a fractional creative strategist or a fractional CMO services to bridge the gaps between um internal teams and external teams so my job is to improve the creative workflow and get it up and running also improve the results from their creative and assist where possible in improving the results for the media buying so the first thing I do is complete this document which goes through the last 30 days what are their winning ads and their potential like winners or like kind of their winners and what this just helps me identify essentially is the the core things that I'm seeing so in the target personas the emotional triggers what type of content is it? Is it just like statics or videos? Is it one style of ad creative type? What's the structure? What's the production type? And then I go into obviously results over here which I'm not really gonna show you because we have results in there but I look at obviously the CPA the roll out the hook the hold outbound CTR frequency insights and what I think would be the next logical steps. Then I start to build out like a bit of a weekly flow of what it would look like with the teams in terms of Monday to Friday and then what's my first goal for this client? We're gonna start with 10 new creatives as a minimum per week and I've kind of broken it into okay, what would the iterations look like? How many iterations do I wanna have and how many net new concepts? And I kind of break this out um with personas or product types and then start mapping this out into a calendar. Now obviously my iterations here will be a little bit more reactive but I like to get my iterations at least 2 weeks ahead and then my monthly plan is all set and stone in terms of my net new concepts based on my research of what's working um or what's not working and what opportunities I can see in personas but also in product. I also have this like Persona Matrix which just kinda tells me which ones I believe are the strongest to focus on um as well as which content pillars um are our priority because we don't have them in the account right now. Now I've been working with this brand for 3 weeks and I haven't even touched an ad yet cause this part is so important to really understand the ad account and Start mapping out your weekly cadence so you can have success with your creative testing.
